articles.202308110:
# Welcome to SJA Analyzer!

Welcome to SJA Plus, a major update after the Scratch edition. SJA Plus offers faster, more detailed and more flexible analysis of Scratch projects.

SJA originally stood for Scratch Json Analyzer. The name was shortened after the analyzer became widely used.

The Scratch and original Python editions revealed many issues and brought valuable feedback. I decided to rebuild the analyzer to address these issues and improve the experience. Project comparison was the original motivation, while analysis helped introduce the tool. As demand changed, the focus shifted toward project analysis.
articles.202502010:
# SJA server migration notice

## Happy Lunar New Year

Thank you for using SJA. The service has been running for four years, including more than a year on the web. As a developer influenced by Scratch, I am glad to contribute to its community.

My studies have delayed features such as archived reports and project comparison. At the time of this announcement, I planned to revisit them at the end of 2025.

By January 25, 2025, SJA had generated more than 6,300 reports. Thank you for your support. Please contact me by email with questions.

## Migration schedule

Server backup and migration were scheduled for February 1 at 22:00 through February 2 at 02:00, Beijing time. Temporary outages were possible during this historical migration.

# SJA service announcement

Following a code refactor, deployment was delayed and the service was unavailable for several days. I apologize for the disruption.

SJA services have now been restored. Feedback and suggestions are welcome.

Future work will focus on reliability and preparing backup services for unexpected outages.
